name: QIDI ABS-GF25 @BBL A1 0.2 nozzle
filament_notes:
QIDI manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 80 C for 6 h.
Manufacturer max speed 120 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed kept at the printer profile's 12 mm3/s; the manufacturer's 120 mm/s (2.7 mm3/s) is a print-speed recommendation, not a limit.
ABRASIVE: fit a hardened nozzle on this printer first.
Manufacturer recommends an enclosure; this printer is open-frame.
Comparison guide: nozzle 250-270 C, bed 90-110 C textured PEI, 30-120 mm/s, fan 0-50 %, drying 70-80 C 4-6 h (required), hardened steel 0.4-0.8 mm, closed chamber required, HDT 87 C. 0.5 kg page: 250-270 C, 40-200 mm/s. Density 1.15, chamber 45 C, bed 100 C, fan 20 % from older wiki table. Sold as 1 kg (qidi-tech-abs-gf25-filament) and 0.5 kg (qidi-tech-abs-gf25-0-5kg-filament) spools.
